Bihar Government to Remove 'Fail' Status from Class 10, 12 Marksheets

The Bihar government is planning to remove the 'Fail' status from the marksheets of students in Class 10 and Class 12. This decision aims to reduce the psychological pressure on students and encourage them to continue their education. The move is intended to prevent students from dropping out of the education system due to the fear of failure.
